description: Seven builder stories: Amodei's pacing plan and its open-weights critique, Smaug open-weight agents, Copilot model updates, self-hosted Coder Agents, Kilo Code local coding, and a new agent-building benchmark.
lead: A pacing debate dominates the last 24 hours, while builders get concrete tools: open-weight agent models, self-hosted coding agents, a local open-source coding assistant, and a benchmark that tests whether agents can build agents. Anthropic's chief proposed independent evaluators and coordinated pacing with support from rival CEOs, a critic argued the plan quietly disadvantages open weights, and Abacus shipped a fine-tuned open-weight agent family. GitHub refreshed Copilot models, Coder went self-hosted, and Sierra open-sourced a long-horizon builder benchmark. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 15, 2026: pacing debate, open agents, and coding tools
